exam_scheme.note: The KPSC Second Division Assistant (SDA) recruitment examination consists of 3 papers: Paper 1 is qualifying Kannada language (SSLC standard); Papers 2 and 3 are competitive objective papers evaluated to determine rank and selection.

stages.source_label: KPSC Group-C Below Degree Level Syllabus & Examination Scheme (KCSR Rules 2021)

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: Compulsory Kannada (Kaddaya Kannada — SSLC standard)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 35% (50 marks out of 150; exempted for candidates with Kannada language in SSLC or higher)

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General English OR General Kannada (Samanya Kannada / Samanya English — PUC / 12th standard)
Paper 3: General Knowledge (Samanya Jnana — Karnataka Geography, Indian History, Daily Science, Basic Civics)

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules under Karnataka State Pay Commission matrix (Scale ₹21,400–₹42,000; Entry Basic Pay ₹21,400). In-hand estimate incorporates mandatory project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 and city-wise HRA (Bengaluru Zone A at 27%, Class B at 18%, Class C taluk centers at 9%).
financial_package.pay_level: Pay Scale ₹21,400 - ₹42,000 (Group C Below Degree Level)
financial_package.pay_source_label: Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules and KPSC SDA Recruitment Specifications
financial_package.estimate_note: Based on Entry Basic Pay of ₹21,400 with 58% DA (₹12,412) and HRA between 9% (₹1,926) and 27% (₹5,778) across taluk to Bengaluru urban postings, less statutory NPS (10% Basic+DA), KGID insurance, and professional tax deductions.
official_perks: Karnataka Government Employees Insurance Scheme (KGID) cover
Medical reimbursement facilities under Karnataka State Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting zone (9%, 18%, 27%)

National Pension System (NPS) with defined State Government contribution matching 14%
Earned leave accumulation and encashment rights
